# Fiveable

> > Fiveable is a comprehensive exam prep platform offering study guides, practice tools, and interactive resources for AP exams, SAT, and college-level coursework.

Fiveable provides structured study materials across sciences, humanities, social sciences, and mathematics. The platform combines guided practice tools, vocabulary resources, and pricing plans designed for individual students, classrooms, and schools preparing for standardized tests and college courses.

## Key Topics

- AP Exam Prep
- Study Guides
- AP US Government
- AP Environmental Science
- AP Physics 1
- Digital SAT
- Practice Questions
- Key Terms & Vocabulary
- Guided Practice
- Exam Preparation
- Student Plans
- Teacher Tools
- AMSCO
- CED Framework
- Interactive Learning

## Exam Prep & Pricing

- [Fiveable Plans & Pricing 2026: AP Study Tools](https://fiveable.me/pricing): Pricing plans for Fiveable AP exam prep across individual, classroom, school tiers
- [SAT (Digital) Study Guides & Practice 2026](https://fiveable.me/digital-sat): Comprehensive Digital SAT exam prep with study guides and practice questions

## AP Sciences & Environmental Studies

- [AP Environmental Science Key Terms & Vocabulary | Fiveable](https://fiveable.me/ap-enviro/key-terms): AP Environmental Science vocabulary study guide organized by unit and topic
- [AP Physics 1 Guided Practice | Fiveable](https://fiveable.me/ap-physics-1-revised/guided-practice): Interactive AP Physics 1 guided practice tool for progress tracking and assessment

## AP Social Sciences & Government

- [AP US Government Key Terms & Vocabulary | Fiveable](https://fiveable.me/ap-gov/key-terms): AP US Government vocabulary study guide with key political and civics terms
- [AP US Government Guided Practice | Fiveable](https://fiveable.me/ap-gov/guided-practice): Interactive AP US Government guided practice tool for diagnostic assessment
- [Criminal Law – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/criminal-law): Criminal Law study guide covering elements of crime, defenses, and criminal acts
- [Corporate Finance – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/corporate-finance): Corporate Finance study guide covering financial statements, budgeting, risk analysis
- [Advertising Strategy - Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/advertising-strategy-and-consumer-insights): Advertising Strategy study guide covering segmentation, consumer behavior, targeting

## Humanities & Literature

- [American Literature – 1860 to Present - Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/american-literature-since-1860): American Literature study guide covering major authors and literary movements
- [Art History I – Prehistory to Middle Ages - Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/art-prehistoric-to-middle-ages): AP Art History study guide covering Paleolithic through Medieval art periods
- [Contemporary Art – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/contemporary-art): Contemporary Art study guide covering postmodernism, pop art, minimalism
- [Art and Social Justice – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/art-and-social-justice): Art and Social Justice study guide covering activism, identity, social movements

## Mathematics & Advanced Topics

- [Computational Mathematics – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/computational-mathematics): Computational Mathematics study guide covering numerical methods and linear algebra
- [Discrete Mathematics – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/discrete-mathematics): Discrete Mathematics study guide covering logic, set theory, algorithms, cryptography
- [Algebraic Logic – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/algebraic-logic): Algebraic Logic study guide covering Boolean algebra and propositional logic
- [C*-algebras – Notes and Study Guides](https://fiveable.me/c-star-algebras): C*-algebras and Banach algebras study guide with functional analysis theorems
